title: The Morning Circuit — Monday, June 01, 2026
description: Top stories: DuckDuckGo makes its ‘no-AI’ search engine easier to access as its traffic booms; Nvidia RTX Spark comes to Windows PCs with Arm CPU, RTX GPU, and unified memory; Revolut rolls out services to thousands of users in India ahead of broader launch; Intel: Our upcoming AI chip will be cheaper, run cooler than Nvidia, AMD options; Strava declares war on scrapers ahead of IPO.
